Origins & Community

Classroom Roots & Purpose.

Our studio was born out of genuine classroom curiosity in Mumbai. We build technology to solve real educational challenges and share the joy of computing with fellow students.

CBSE Bhavani Shankar School · Dadar, Mumbai

Born In The School Computer Lab

Neel, Aarush, and Ansh met in the classrooms of CBSE Bhavani Shankar School (Mumbai Public School). Tired of passive textbook slides, they spent lunch periods and free lab hours writing interactive JavaScript experiments to visualize planetary gravity and simulate keyboard ergonomics. That classroom camaraderie remains the heartbeat of Class Of Learners today.

Explore Our School Journey & Campus Lab
Social Impact · Sneh Asha Initiative

Software Engineered For Impact

Guided by Siddhi Jaiswal and inspired by the Sneh Asha Foundation, our engineering is committed to bridging the digital divide. Every application is built with 100% offline capability, zero subscription fees, and ultra-lightweight asset footprints so students in under-resourced schools can access premier educational tools without hardware barriers.

Discover The Sneh Asha Initiative
What We Value

Engineering Principles.

We build software to understand foundational computing, solve practical problems, and deliver sovereign tools without corporate bloat.

Learn By Building

We write our physics, shaders, and state engines directly in vanilla JavaScript, WebGL, and C++/Python rather than relying on black-box boilerplates. Writing the underlying mathematics from scratch is how we truly master systems.

Measured 60 FPS Web

We engineer for silky 60fps render loops, sub-15ms frame budgets, and ultra-lean network payloads (<100KB gzipped). Tools boot instantly and run fluidly even on modest school laptops and older mobile hardware.

Open, Client-Side & Private

Every tool runs directly inside your browser. Zero downloads required, zero tracking cookies, zero user surveillance, and zero paywalls. Your educational progress belongs entirely to you on your local device.

Classroom-Tested Resilience

Every application is an active workbench tested with our classmates. We continually refine simulations based on real feedback, optimize keyboard and touch ergonomics, and push stability updates without downtime.

Our Journey

From Classroom Ideas To Living Engines.

Early 2024 · The Classroom Spark

Foundational Prototypes in Dadar

Neel Badri, Aarush Vangari, and Ansh Patil began collaborating during computer lab hours at CBSE Bhavani Shankar School in Dadar, Mumbai, brainstorming interactive web experiments to explore physics formulas, orbital math, and algorithmic state machines.

Mid 2024 · First Public Engines

Public Launch of ATI & 3D Solar System

Shipped the inaugural releases of Advanced Typing Instructor (ATI) with WebAudio synthesis and the 3D Solar System Engine. Prioritized 100% offline capability, zero external dependencies, and raw canvas speed so classmates could run them on basic school laptops.

Late 2024 · Platform Unification & Growth

Unified Studio Architecture & Contributors

Launched Class Of Learners as a unified platform with shared design tokens, keyboard navigation, light/dark mica themes, and client-side settings synchronization. Welcomed contributors Yashraj Jadhav and Aaryaman Jadhav for Terra3D alongside stealth core engineering guidance from John Doe.

Early 2025 · Multimodal Interfaces

GestureUI & CastFlow Streaming

Engineered GestureUI for zero-hardware computer-vision hand tracking over webcams and CastFlow for sub-second wireless screen streaming with desktop presentation modes, pushing browser capabilities to native-app thresholds.

2025 — Present · Urban Simulation & Native Apps

Mumbai Traffic 3D & Native Mobility

Released the 3D Mumbai Traffic Simulator with realistic urban physics, auto-rickshaw kinematics, and driving missions guided by Avantika Raskar. Compiled full native Android APKs for mobile accessibility while preserving our zero-tracking, zero-paywall promise.
